Fairfax County Public Schools
FY27 Proposed Budget Overview
The FY27 School Operating Fund budget totals
$4.1 billion, a net increase of $197.0 million, or
5.0%, over the FY26 Approved Budget.

FCPS is estimating $77.0 million in tuition revenue
from the City of Fairfax to provide educational
services for city students in FY 2027. The increase
is primarily due to increases in FCPS’ operational
costs and the proportion of city students to total
enrollment. FCPS projected the City’s average
daily membership (ADM) for FY 2027 to be 3,103.
